name: rosetta-crc-32
code:
use default

let table = (0..256)
    |> map(n => (0..8) |> reduce(cast uint(n), (c, _) =>
        if (c & 1u) != 0u then 0xEDB88320u ^ (c >> 1) else c >> 1 fi))
    |> collect_list()

crc32(data: ubyte[]) -> uint is
    let step = (crc: uint, b: ubyte) =>
        table[cast int((crc ^ cast uint(b)) & 0xFFu)] ^ (crc >> 8)

    (data |> reduce(0xFFFFFFFFu, step)) ^ 0xFFFFFFFFu
